entries.en:
Despite Mogek's attempts to dissuade him, one of his Mogmenders is convinced that searching the House of Letters will yield the construction materials they have long been eager to strike off of their ever-growing list of necessary items. However, days have passed since he set out on his own for the ruins, and Mogek begins to worry for the moogle's safety. He bids you make your way to the House of Letters and seek out the stubborn moogle.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

* Cette quête est  synchronisée avec votre niveau.

Mogek voudrait que vous alliez voir le Mog collecteur. Il a pris la route de la Maison des lettreux avec d'autres Mogs célestes pour y chercher des matériaux à recycler, mais personne ne les a vus revenir depuis. Mogek a sous-entendu que ses congénères avaient sans doute trop honte de rentrer les mains vides, mais il n'a pas l'air rassuré malgré tout... Allez voir à la Maison des lettreux si le Mog collecteur et ses semblables vont bien.

entries.en:
You come across a moogle who is so immersed in his work he does not notice you approach. Startled by your sudden appearance, he quickly recovers and goes on to explain that he is disappointed by the overall quality of the materials he has unearthed from the House of Letters. Knowing Mogek will not be satisfied by what he has gathered, he begs you to use your superior crafting skills to repurpose the  materials he has found into construction components and deliver them to Mogek the Marvelous.

※In the event you lose the materials or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with the mettlesome moogle.

entries.en: The construction materials you deliver to Mogek seem to convince him that the ruins hold far more potential than he had believed. He decides he will begin sending Mogmenders to thoroughly scour the area for materials in the near future.

entries.en: He has been absent for days, and being the hardhead he is, I'm sure he will not return until he has collected an assortment of planks, paints, and pilings large enough to prove me wrong.

...Oh! Thank the gods it's you. As glad as I am to see your friendly face, I beg of you not to sneak up on me like that!

entries.en: Perhaps I was too quick to discount the potential the ruins offered. It is a mistake I mean to rectify immediately, kupo! I shall begin scheduling routine searches of the area... Just as soon as I get the rest of my Mogmenders in order, that is!
entries.fr: Laissons-les chercher tranquillement dans ce cas. Merci à vous... Si vous n'aviez pas été là, qui sait quand ils auraient daigné m'annoncer qu'ils avaient fait ces trouvailles, kuppo !
entries.ja:
これからも、再利用できるものがないか、
仲間に探してもらうことにしますくぽ。
どうもありがとうございましたくぽ。
